summary: City of Arlington first-party material and a current anonymous ArcGIS Tax Parcel layer were verified. The exact WUP point returned zero; a bounded envelope returned three safe parcel polygons. Coverage is not citywide-verified and runtime remains held pending serial review.

requestOutcomes.outcome: City page says Arlington Maps Online can identify Tax Parcel features and provides the official plat-search workflow.
Current ArcGIS Feature Layer named Tax Parcel; polygon geometry; service CRS WKID 102738/latest 2276; fields include stable TaxParcelId and unsafe fields were not requested.
Exact WUP point [-97.0729125498606,32.7174112900959] was queried as longitude/latitude in EPSG:4326; no feature returned. This is not evidence of citywide absence.
Envelope -97.08,32.71,-97.06,32.73 in EPSG:4326 returned three parcel polygons with TaxParcelId values 4201521, 4201522 and 4201523; output reprojected to EPSG:4326 and retained as a bounded sample.

requestCoordinates.coordinateOrderNote: WUP point preserved exactly in latitude/longitude order; service request used the corresponding longitude/latitude query encoding; no coordinate was shifted.

geometryQuality: Three bounded parcel polygons retained unchanged from the GeoJSON response except for removing all source properties other than canonical id; geometries are closed polygons and are not exact-point hits.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: City of Arlington, Texas OpenData property service.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Anonymous access to the Tax Parcel layer and a bounded ID-plus-geometry response.

scopeLimits: A bounded sample does not establish citywide completeness or update currency.
The exact WUP point miss is not evidence of citywide parcel absence.
The ArcGIS response indicated exceededTransferLimit=true; no larger raw response was retained.
No owner, address, titleholder, contact, personal, tax/account, or other unsafe fields were requested, logged or retained.
Packet completion is research evidence only and does not admit a runtime adapter.
serialReviewerQualification: not qualified; independent serial review and adapter qualification still required
uncertainty: The city service is public and the layer schema/CRS are exposed, but this attempt did not prove citywide coverage, completeness, temporal currency, or adapter compatibility.
